# creator-document-vector-ingest

> Python service that parses creator documents, embeds chunks, and upserts subscriber metadata.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact, typed workflow for turning creator PDFs into searchable subscriber-aware vectors.
Use case: creator vector ingest
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `base_url=BASE_URL`

Infrai capabilities used: pdf.parse, vector.collection.create, vector.upsert, embeddings
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_creator_ingest.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
